cities.name: Antwerpen
cities.area: Central Antwerp: the districts Antwerpen, Berchem (incl. Zurenborg) and Borgerhout
cities.description: Table and the City: a curated, filterable guide to Antwerpen's best tables: restaurants, cafés & bars, coffee and artisan bakeries, with opening hours and ratings.
cities.about: Antwerpen is the second city in the guide. The base list covers central Antwerp (the districts Antwerpen, Berchem with Zurenborg, and Borgerhout) and comes from OpenStreetMap, with the guide’s usual rules: no chains, fast food, friteries or student cafés, no generic cafés or coffee houses, artisan bakeries only. Ratings come from Google; permanently closed places are left out. On top of that come 131 hand-picked places from the Michelin Guide, Gault&Millau 2026, local press and the places’ own websites, plus announced openings. Nothing is invented: anything we could not verify is shown as unknown.

Nothing is invented: anything we could not verify is shown as unknown.
